lines.text: In 1901 sponge divers off Antikythera found a wreck full of bronze.
Among the statues lay a lump of corroded metal the size of a book.
It sat in a museum drawer for fifty years before anyone looked inside.
X-rays found thirty gears, cut by hand, meshing.
It predicted eclipses, and it tracked the moon's changing speed.
Nothing this complex was built again for fourteen hundred years.
